name: Renko Level EA
summary: This EA trades based on Renko chart levels, entering positions when price breaks above or below key Renko brick levels. It uses Renko brick construction logic to identify trend direction and executes trades on brick reversals or continuations. The strategy aims to capture clean trend moves by filtering out market noise through the Renko price-based charting method.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Renko图表级别进行交易，当价格突破关键Renko砖块级别时入场。它使用Renko砖块构建逻辑来识别趋势方向，并在砖块反转或延续时执行交易。该策略旨在通过基于价格的Renko图表方法过滤市场噪音，捕捉干净的趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用Renko砖块的价格突破来识别趋势方向和交易信号。Renko图表不考虑时间因素，仅根据价格变动来构建砖块，因此能有效过滤市场噪音。入场条件方面，当价格形成新的同色砖块时顺势入场，表示趋势延续；当出现砖块颜色反转时则可能反转入场或平仓。出场条件依赖于Renko砖块的反转信号，即出现N块反向砖块时平仓或反向开仓。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式。资金管理方面，EA可能设置止损在最近的Renko水平下方/上方，但具体取决于参数配置。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA uses Renko brick price breakouts to identify trend direction and generate trading signals. Renko charts disregard time and only construct bricks based on price movement, effectively filtering out market noise. For entry conditions, the EA enters in the direction of the trend when a new same-color brick forms, indicating trend continuation; when a brick color reversal occurs, it may either reverse the position or close existing trades. Exit conditions rely on Renko brick reversal signals, typically closing positions or reversing when N opposing bricks appear. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or a percentage of account balance approach. Money management incorporates stop losses placed below/above the nearest Renko level, though the specifics depend on parameter configuration. The overall strategy logic is clear and well-suited for trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy sideways conditions leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Initial lot size, martingale base quantity

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: BrickReversalCount
parameters.description_en: Number of bricks for reversal confirmation

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

pros: Renko砖块有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号干扰
策略逻辑清晰直观，基于价格突破易于理解和验证
不受时间框架限制，专注于价格行为本身，适合趋势跟踪
参数可调性强，砖块大小和反转数量均可根据品种优化
pros_en: Renko bricks effectively filter market noise, reducing false signal interference
Clear and intuitive strategy logic based on price breakouts that is easy to understand and verify
Time-independent approach focuses purely on price action, well-suited for trend following
Highly adjustable parameters allow optimization of brick size and reversal count per instrument
cons: 在震荡市场中容易产生频繁的虚假突破信号导致连续亏损
Renko砖块大小参数对策略表现影响极大，设置不当会严重影响效果
缺乏多时间周期确认机制，单一Renko信号容易受突发事件影响
没有明显的资金管理策略如动态仓位或风险比例计算
cons_en: Prone to frequent false breakout signals in choppy/sideways markets leading to consecutive losses
Renko box size parameter has extreme impact on performance; improper settings severely degrade results
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, single Renko signals are vulnerable to sudden market events
No advanced money management such as dynamic position sizing or risk-proportional lot calculation
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，在大周期趋势方向过滤小周期信号
加入动态砖块大小计算，根据ATR自动调整以适应市场波动性变化
引入资金管理模块，根据账户风险比例动态计算仓位大小
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation to filter signals in the direction of the higher timeframe trend
Implement dynamic Renko box size calculation using ATR to automatically adapt to market volatility changes
Introduce a money management module that dynamically calculates position size based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 缺乏多时间周期过滤可能导致逆势交易风险
震荡市中砖块频繁反转可能造成连续止损
砖块大小参数固定不适应市场波动性变化
risk_points_en: Lack of multi-timeframe filtering may lead to counter-trend trading risk
Frequent brick reversals in choppy markets can cause consecutive stop losses
Fixed brick size parameter does not adapt to changing market volatility
